list.name: page
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT page FROM experience.events ORDER BY page

targets.query: SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS t, avg(value) AS fcp FROM experience.events WHERE type='vitals' AND name='FCP' AND ($page = 'All' OR page IN ($page)) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS t, avg(value) AS lcp FROM experience.events WHERE type='vitals' AND name='LCP' AND ($page = 'All' OR page IN ($page)) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS t, avg(value) AS inp FROM experience.events WHERE type='vitals' AND name='INP' AND ($page = 'All' OR page IN ($page)) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS t, count() AS longtask FROM experience.events WHERE type='longtask' AND ($page = 'All' OR page IN ($page)) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS t, count() AS errors FROM experience.events WHERE type='error' AND ($page = 'All' OR page IN ($page)) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT JSONExtractString(data, 'message') AS message, count() AS cnt FROM experience.events WHERE type='error' GROUP BY message ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
